## User Story

**As a** developer  
**I want** a multi-provider LLM interface in stem  
**So that** Jarvis can call Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama through one protocol

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `stem/llm/providers.py` defines `LLMProvider` protocol
- [ ] `AnthropicProvider`, `OpenAIProvider`, `OllamaProvider` classes exist
- [ ] Each provider supports `generate()` and `stream()` methods
- [ ] Unit test for each provider

## Story Points

**Estimate:** 5

Sprint 1

E1 — stem Kernel & Jarvis CLI
